Class SpatialIndexRanges

java.lang.Object
org.locationtech.geomesa.trino.spatial.iceberg.transforms.SpatialIndexRanges
public final class SpatialIndexRanges extends Object
Hex-encoded Z2/XZ2 index ranges covering a JTS query envelope, for pushdown against hex-partitioned storage columns (__<X>_z2__ / __<X>_xz2__).

Endpoints are encoded with Z2SFC.hexEncode/XZ2SFC.hexEncode (via SpaceFillingCurves), which left-align the significant bits so lexicographic comparison over the fixed-width strings matches numeric comparison of the underlying index values. That makes the inclusive [lo, hi] ranges directly usable both as VARCHAR domains on the full column value and — because prefix order is preserved — under Iceberg truncate(width) partition projection at any width.
